ConnectorOperationRequirement.description: Declared contract for a single connector operation used by the flow.

default_resolution_mode.description: Resolution mode used when a node does not override it.

nodes.description: Aliases of the nodes that declare this operation (sorted).

requires_bound_connection.description: True when any node selects `bound_connection`: a connection instance must be bound for this operation in bindings.lock before the flow can run.

roles.description: Auth/endpoint role requirements declared by the connector crate (`ConnectorOpMetadata.roles`). Lock-time binding must satisfy each role with a handle of the expected kind.

selected_resolution_modes.description: Resolution modes actually selected by nodes in this flow (sorted, deduplicated).

supported_resolution_modes.description: Resolution modes the operation supports, in declaration order.

ConnectorRequirement.description: Requirements contributed by one connector family.

operations.description: Operations of this connector the flow may invoke.

ConnectorRoleKindDecl.description: Declarative connector role kinds used by node and connector-op metadata.

ConnectorRoleRequirementIR.description: Serializable connector role requirement emitted into Flow IR.

DurabilityRequirements.description:
Durability mode and the host services it implies.

Derivation mirrors host-inproc preflight (`collect_missing_durability_services`) so a planner can provision exactly what preflight will demand.

has_halting_nodes.description: True when any node is a halting boundary (suspend + resume).

needs_checkpoint_blob_store.description: A checkpoint blob store must be bound (blob spill threshold configured while checkpointing is enabled).

needs_checkpoint_store.description: A checkpoint store must be bound (mode is not `off`).

needs_resume_scheduler.description: A resume scheduler must be bound (halting timer nodes present).

needs_resume_signal_source.description: A resume signal source must be bound (halting callback/approval nodes present).

EffectHint.description: Canonical typed resource hint (dag_core::EffectHint). Unknown strings fail closed at validation time (EFFECT202).

EffectRequirements.description: Typed capability requirements for a flow.

families.description: Capability families implied by `union` (e.g. `resource::http` for `resource::http::read`), sorted by canonical string.

per_node.description: Per-node attribution: node alias to its declared hints. Only nodes declaring at least one capability hint appear. This is what a debugger inspects.

union.description: Flow-wide union of declared capability hints, sorted by canonical string. This is what a planner provisions.

EntrypointRequirement.description: External ingress wiring for one entrypoint.

deadline_ms.description: Response deadline in milliseconds. Not recorded in Flow IR metadata today; populated during bundle assembly from the flow registry's entrypoint specs when available.

route_aliases.description: Non-authoritative aliases for the canonical route.

FlowIdentity.description: Identity of the flow a requirements manifest describes.

id.description: Stable flow identifier (UUIDv5 of name + version).

version.description: Semantic version string of the flow.

HostConstraints.description: Host constraints derivable from the IR today.

has_subflows.description: Flow embeds subflow nodes; the host must support subflow expansion.

requires_connector_runtime.description: At least one connector operation is selected in `bound_connection` mode, so the host must provide a connector runtime (today) or a resolved bindings.lock (once lock-time resolution lands, packet C2).

requires_wasm32_compatibility.description: Flow targets the WASM profile and must compile/execute on wasm32.

TriggerKind.description: Kind of trigger surface, as derivable from the IR today.

oneOf.description: Trigger is wired to an HTTP entrypoint (route/method declared).
Trigger has no entrypoint wiring recorded in the IR; invocation mechanism is host-defined.

TriggerRequirement.description: A trigger node that originates executions of the flow.

description: Static requirements manifest for a flow: capability hints, connector contracts, durability services, trigger/entrypoint surface, and host constraints, derived entirely from validated Flow IR without executing anything.

connectors.description: Connector operation requirements, grouped by connector family.

durability.description: Durability mode and the host services it implies.

flow.description: Identity of the flow this manifest describes.

flow_ir_hash.description: Hash of the serialized Flow IR this manifest was derived from (`sha256:<hex>`), populated at bundle-assembly time. The enclosing bundle id is intentionally NOT embedded: the manifest is hashed into the bundle id, so embedding it would be circular.

host.description: Host constraints derivable from the IR today.

profile.description: Target execution profile declared by the flow.

triggers.description: Trigger nodes that originate executions of this flow.
